title: Power Automate: Delinea Secret Server as a credential provider for desktop flows
summary: Pass with gaps: the roadmap details and existing credential controls are supported, and searches did not find Delinea-specific documentation. The assertions that a stored identity retrieves the password and that the machine credentials are privileged are unsupported. Qualify the logging assurance with Microsoft's sensitive-variable security update and make the REST calls explicit.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Dataverse credential records support the GrantAccess, ModifyAccess and RevokeAccess actions.
claims.quote: The following operations can be used with the credential entity type. ... GrantAccess | Not Bound ... ModifyAccess | Not Bound ... RevokeAccess | Not Bound
claims.fix: Replace the descriptive call with explicit unbound REST calls: POST [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/GrantAccess; POST [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/ModifyAccess; POST [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/RevokeAccess. Link the corresponding /webapi/reference/grantaccess, /modifyaccess and /revokeaccess pages and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/use-web-api-actions. GrantAccess and ModifyAccess take Target and PrincipalAccess; RevokeAccess takes Target and Revokee.

claims.claim: The CyberArk Get credential action produces a variable marked as sensitive.
